states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.description: Andhra Pradesh, the Sun-Kissed Jewel of the Coromandel Coast, unfolds across nearly 1,000 kilometers of pristine Bay of Bengal shoreline, the emerald Eastern Ghats, sacred Seven Hills of Tirumala, the Grand Canyon of Gandikota, and the fertile deltas of the Godavari and Krishna rivers.
states.short_description: Capital: Amaravati • Tirumala Hills, Gandikota Canyon & Coastal Beaches
states.tagline: Discover the Beauty of Andhra Pradesh

states.name: Arunachal Pradesh
states.description: Arunachal Pradesh, perched on India's northeastern frontier, is an ethereal sanctuary of snow-capped Himalayan peaks, ancient Buddhist monasteries, deep river gorges, and vibrant tribal traditions.
states.short_description: Capital: Itanagar • Land of Dawn-Lit Mountains & Tawang
states.tagline: Land of the Dawn-Lit Mountains

states.name: Assam
states.description: Assam is blessed by the mighty Brahmaputra River, sprawling emerald tea plantations, world-heritage wildlife sanctuaries protecting the one-horned rhinoceros, and rich Ahom dynasty heritage.
states.short_description: Capital: Dispur • Kaziranga Rhinos & Brahmaputra Valley
states.tagline: Gateway to the Northeast and Land of the Red River

states.name: Bihar
states.description: Bihar is steeped in millennial history as the birthplace of Buddhism and Jainism, home to the ancient seat of learning Nalanda, the sacred Mahabodhi Temple in Bodh Gaya, and the holy Ganges River plains.
states.short_description: Capital: Patna • Bodh Gaya Enlightenment & Ancient Nalanda
states.tagline: The Cradle of Ancient Empires and Spiritual Enlightenment

states.name: Chhattisgarh
states.description: Chhattisgarh boasts dense sal forests, the majestic Chitrakote Horseshoe Falls on the Indravati River, ancient rock-cut cave temples, and centuries-old Bastar tribal metalcraft and bell-metal arts.
states.short_description: Capital: Raipur • Chitrakote Horseshoe Falls & Bastar Crafts
states.tagline: The Green Heart of India and Citadel of Waterfalls

states.name: Goa
states.description: Goa captivates with its sun-drenched golden beaches, UNESCO World Heritage Portuguese churches in Old Goa, tranquil spice plantations, Latin Quarters in Fontainhas, and relaxed coastal culture.
states.short_description: Capital: Panaji • Sun-kissed Beaches & Latin Quarters
states.tagline: Pearl of the Orient and Sun-Kissed Coast

states.name: Gujarat
states.description: Gujarat is a dynamic tapestry of vibrant heritage, featuring the ethereal white salt desert of the Rann of Kutch, the last sanctuary of the Asiatic Lion in Gir, and monumental stepwells and temples.
states.short_description: Capital: Gandhinagar • White Rann of Kutch & Asiatic Lions
states.tagline: Land of the Legends, Asiatic Lions, and White Desert

states.name: Haryana
states.description: Haryana bridges ancient heritage and modern vitality, home to the sacred epic battleground of Kurukshetra, prehistoric Indus Valley sites at Rakhigarhi, and scenic bird sanctuaries.
states.short_description: Capital: Chandigarh • Epic Kurukshetra & Sultanpur Bird Sanctuary
states.tagline: The Historic Battlefield of Epics and Modern Progress

states.name: Himachal Pradesh
states.description: Himachal Pradesh is a breathtaking alpine wonderland of snow-capped mountains, apple orchards, swift mountain rivers, ancient wooden temples, and peaceful Tibetan Buddhist monasteries.
states.short_description: Capital: Shimla • Kullu Manali, Spiti Valley & Snow Valleys
states.tagline: Land of Gods and Snow-Capped Himalayan Valleys

states.name: Jharkhand
states.description: Jharkhand is endowed with pristine forested hills, sparkling cascades like Hundru and Dassam Falls, sacred Jain shrines at Parasnath, and the vibrant tribal art traditions of Sohrai and Khovar.
states.short_description: Capital: Ranchi • Land of Forests, Dassam Falls & Parasnath
states.tagline: The Land of Forests, Minerals, and Cascading Waterfalls

states.name: Karnataka
states.description: Karnataka presents an incredible spectrum of travel experiences, from the UNESCO World Heritage stone palaces of Hampi and Pattadakal to the misty coffee peaks of Coorg and pristine coastal beaches.
states.short_description: Capital: Bengaluru • Ancient Hampi, Mysore Palace & Coorg Hills
states.tagline: One State, Many Worlds — Heritage, Hills, and High-Tech

states.name: Kerala
states.description: Kerala is a world-renowned tropical paradise of serene palm-fringed backwater lagoons, spice-laden Western Ghat mountains in Munnar, Ayurvedic healing retreats, and classical Kathakali arts.
states.short_description: Capital: Thiruvananthapuram • God's Own Country, Backwaters & Munnar
states.tagline: God's Own Country — Backwaters, Beaches, and Spice Hills

states.name: Madhya Pradesh
states.description: Madhya Pradesh boasts an unparalleled wealth of heritage and wildlife, including the UNESCO-listed temples of Khajuraho, the Buddhist Stupa at Sanchi, and India's finest tiger reserves.
states.short_description: Capital: Bhopal • The Heart of India, Khajuraho Temples & Kanha
states.tagline: The Heart of Incredible India and Tiger State

states.name: Maharashtra
states.description: Maharashtra combines the cosmopolitan energy of Mumbai with the ancient rock-cut art of Ajanta and Ellora, historic hilltop citadels of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, and the Konkan coast.
states.short_description: Capital: Mumbai • Gateway of India, Ajanta Ellora Caves & Sahyadris
states.tagline: Gateway of India and Land of Valiant Maratha Forts

states.name: Manipur
states.description: Manipur, surrounded by rolling hills and blue valleys, is celebrated for the world-unique floating phumdis of Loktak Lake, the endangered Sangai brow-antlered deer, and rich handloom arts.
states.short_description: Capital: Imphal • Floating Phumdis of Loktak Lake & Kangla Fort
states.tagline: Jeweled Land of the Floating Keibul Lamjao

states.name: Meghalaya
states.description: Meghalaya is world-renowned for its mist-draped hills, living root bridges bio-engineered by the Khasi people, majestic waterfalls at Cherrapunji, and crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River at Dawki.
states.short_description: Capital: Shillong • Abode of Clouds, Cherrapunji & Living Root Bridges
states.tagline: Abode of Clouds and Land of Living Root Bridges

states.name: Mizoram
states.description: Mizoram charms travelers with its tranquil pine-covered ridges, pleasant highland climate, cliffside bamboo cottages, warm Mizo hospitality, and pristine waterfalls.
states.short_description: Capital: Aizawl • Serene Blue Mountains, Vantawng Falls & Bamboo Groves
states.tagline: Land of Blue Mountains and Rolling Bamboo Hills

states.name: Nagaland
states.description: Nagaland is celebrated across the world for the vibrant Hornbill Festival, the breathtaking high-altitude alpine meadows of Dzukou Valley, and rich tribal heritage.
states.short_description: Capital: Kohima • Hornbill Festival, Dzukou Valley & Tribal Culture
states.tagline: Land of Festivals, Green Ridges, and Dzukou Valley

states.name: Odisha
states.description: Odisha is famed for the colossal 13th-century Konark Sun Temple chariot, the sacred seaside temple of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Chilika Lake lagoon, and pristine virgin beaches.
states.short_description: Capital: Bhubaneswar • Konark Sun Temple, Jagannath Puri & Chilika
states.tagline: India's Best Kept Secret — Ancient Temples and Coastal Sands

states.name: Punjab
states.description: Punjab is renowned for the divine radiance of the Golden Temple in Amritsar, rich agricultural fields of golden wheat and mustard, heroic patriotic memorials, and vibrant Bhangra culture.
states.short_description: Capital: Chandigarh • Golden Temple Amritsar & Heart of the Five Rivers
states.tagline: Land of Five Rivers, Golden Shrines, and Warmth

states.name: Rajasthan
states.description: Rajasthan radiates majestic royal splendor with the Pink City of Jaipur, romantic lake palaces of Udaipur, golden sands of Jaisalmer, imposing desert forts, and rich royal heritage.
states.short_description: Capital: Jaipur • Land of Royal Kings, Thar Desert & Amber Fort
states.tagline: Land of Royalty, Mighty Fortresses, and Thar Dunes

states.name: Sikkim
states.description: Sikkim is a pristine Himalayan jewel crowned by Mount Kanchenjunga, high-altitude alpine lakes like Tsomgo, sacred Buddhist monasteries, and vibrant rhododendron valleys.
states.short_description: Capital: Gangtok • Kanchenjunga Peaks, Rumtek & Tsomgo Lake
states.tagline: The Himalayan Kingdom of Kanchenjunga

states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.description: Tamil Nadu is a treasure trove of classical Dravidian culture, featuring soaring temple gopurams in Madurai and Thanjavur, misty Nilgiri tea hills in Ooty, and rich Carnatic arts.
states.short_description: Capital: Chennai • Dravidian Architecture, Madurai & Nilgiri Ooty
states.tagline: Land of Grand Dravidian Temples and Classical Arts

states.name: Telangana
states.description: Telangana unites rich medieval history with 21st-century innovation, home to the iconic Charminar and Golconda Fort in Hyderabad, and the UNESCO-recognized Ramappa Temple.
states.short_description: Capital: Hyderabad • Historic Charminar, Golconda & Ramappa Temple
states.tagline: Land of Kakatiya Heritage, Golconda Fort, and Pearls

states.name: Tripura
states.description: Tripura enchants with the palatial grandeur of Ujjayanta and Neermahal water palaces, colossal rock-cut Shiva sculptures at Unakoti, and lush green bamboo forests.
states.short_description: Capital: Agartala • Water Palace Neermahal & Ujjayanta Palace
states.tagline: Land of Palaces, Ancient Rock Sculptures, and Forests

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.description: Uttar Pradesh is the cultural heartland of India, home to the timeless Taj Mahal in Agra, sacred Ganga Aarti on the ancient ghats of Varanasi, and Ayodhya.
states.short_description: Capital: Lucknow • Iconic Taj Mahal, Sacred Varanasi & Ayodhya
states.tagline: The Heartland of India, Sacred Ghats, and Iconic Wonders

states.name: Uttarakhand
states.description: Uttarakhand is celebrated for the holy Char Dham pilgrimage, soaring Garhwal and Kumaon Himalayas, yoga retreats of Rishikesh, and the sacred origins of the Ganges and Yamuna rivers.
states.short_description: Capital: Dehradun • Land of the Gods, Rishikesh, Haridwar & Kedarnath
states.tagline: Devbhoomi — Land of the Gods and Sacred Himalayan Peaks

states.name: West Bengal
states.description: West Bengal, stretching from the snow-capped Himalayas in the north to the Bay of Bengal in the south, is an enchanting tapestry of rich history, vibrant art, lush tea gardens, terracotta temples, and the mystical Sundarbans mangrove forests.
states.short_description: Capital: Kolkata • Cultural Capital, Tea Hills & Sundarbans
states.tagline: Discover the Beauty of West Bengal

states.name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands
states.description: Capital: Port Blair • Radhanagar Beach, Cellular Jail & Coral Reefs
states.short_description: Capital: Port Blair • Radhanagar Beach, Cellular Jail & Coral Reefs
states.tagline: Discover the Beauty of Andaman and Nicobar Islands

states.description: Joint Capital • The City Beautiful, Rock Garden & Sukhna Lake

states.tagline: Discover the Beauty of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

states.short_description: Capital of India • Red Fort, India Gate, Qutub Minar & Humayun's Tomb
states.tagline: Discover the Beauty of Delhi
